releases.name: v1.8.0 — Native Windows Support, Strict Responses Proxy Fix & State-Machine Refactor
releases.body:
## Highlights

- **Native Windows (`win32`) Support & `windows-latest` CI (Fixes #5)**:
  - Kernel-backed single-instance locking on Windows via libuv `UV_FS_O_EXLOCK` (`dwShareMode = 0`) on a persistent `.state.lock` handle with an immediate fail-closed `EBUSY` self-probe (zero PID-reclamation races or PID-reuse lockouts).
  - Locale-independent SID-based `icacls.exe` ACL hardening (`*S-1-5-18`, `*S-1-5-32-544`, and current local `S-1-5-*` / Entra ID `S-1-12-1-*` user SID), bounded `renameSync` retry on transient Defender `EPERM`/`EACCES`/`EBUSY`, `SIGBREAK` handling, and `pathToFileURL` + Winsock env fixes in `scripts/run-current-contract.mjs`.
  - Verified on GitHub Actions `windows-latest` (`current-contract` + `windows-native` NTFS lock, cross-process contention, forced-kill recovery, 4-way race, `.env`, and loopback `/health` checks).
- **Strict Responses Proxy Compatibility (Fixes #6)**:
  - Qualified usable `POST /v1/responses` SSE `response.completed` events now always emit `response.error: null` while preserving `incomplete: true`, `incomplete_details: { reason: "upstream_interrupted", code }`, and `res.incomplete = true` (preventing resumption cache retention)—stopping reconnect loops on strict OpenAI Responses proxies (e.g., Codex Desktop via Cockpit Tools).
  - `response.failed`, `response.incomplete`, and non-streaming partial responses keep `error` intact.
- **Sticky Session & Image Blob Cache Preservation**:
  - Verified `post_tool` and `post_output` idle stalls no longer poison `session.lastFailure` or thrash per-account image `blobCache` on subsequent turns; `X-Gemini-Recovery-Errors` is only emitted on actual retry attempts.
- **State-Machine Refactor & Strict JSON Recovery**:
  - Closed, privacy-safe `TOOL_JSON_REASONS` syntax subcodes in `parseBoundedJson()` with targeted recovery directives appended at the **prompt tail** and 2 uncommitted `tool_protocol` retries across Gateway, Pi, and OpenCode.
  - Converged `response-delivery.mjs` onto monotonic 4-state `wirePhase`, replaced O(N^2) per-frame idle probing in `native-provider.mjs` with O(1) `classifyIdleSnapshot()` + pure `selectIdleDeadline()`, unified `pool.mjs` retry planning in pure `planRetry()`, fixed OpenCode `post_tool` stall handling, and added committed multi-call tail salvage in Pi/OpenCode.
  - Added synthetic 150K-token HTTP/2 adversarial long-context suite (`test/gateway-long-context-adversarial.test.mjs`).

## Extension Packages
- `pi-gemini-app@0.1.11`
- `openclaw-gemini-app@0.1.7`
- `mcp-gemini-app@0.1.2`
- `opencode-gemini-app@0.1.2`

releases.name: v1.7.1 — Keepalive Headers, Idle Anchoring, HTTP/2 Watchdog & Large Image Upload Recovery
releases.body:
## Highlights

### Streaming & Timeout Reliability
- **45s Comment-Only SSE Keepalive Headers** (`/v1/chat/completions`): Flushes HTTP `200 text/event-stream` + `: keepalive` heartbeats at 45s while buffering large slow `tool_call` blocks (20–35 KB), preventing 300s client/SDK header timeouts without committing output or breaking uncommitted retry safety.
- **Anchored Idle Timers (No Infinite Waits)**: Locks `post_complete`, `post_tool`, `post_output`, and `post_tool_error` deadlines to actual text/completion progress so repeated duplicate or metadata-only frames can never reset idle timers forever.
- **Smarter Tool-Block Idle Probing**: Distinguishes `tool_choice: 'required'` preambles and still-streaming 2nd tool calls (`TRUNCATED_TOOL_CALL`) from closed invalid tool blocks, preventing premature cancellations while promptly closing stalled malformed tool calls.
- **HTTP/2 PING ACK Watchdog (30s)**: Detects unresponsive upstream HTTP/2 sessions cleanly with `client.connecting` guards, `ERR_HTTP2_PING_CANCEL` handling, and monotonic sequence tracking.

### Large Image Upload Stability
- **Byte-Budget Upload Pacing (4 MiB In-Flight Cap)**: Keeps small images uploading in parallel while automatically pacing multi-megabyte PNG bursts (e.g., 4–7 × 2.9 MiB screenshots) so they no longer overwhelm a single HTTP/2 upload session.
- **Incremental Blob Caching & Sequential Reset Retry**: Preserves completed uploads immediately in `blobCache` via `onUploaded`, retries remaining uncached images on fresh HTTP/2 sessions (`concurrency: 1`), and classifies `NATIVE_IMAGE_UPLOAD_RESET` for gateway-level transient failover.

### Tool Protocol & Test Speed
- **Mid-Stream Tool Error Recovery**: Defers mid-stream `TOOL_ERRORS` to `validate` with exact `postFenceOffset` tracking and a shared 1-retry `tool_protocol` cap.
- **Parallel Offline Product Suite**: Runs the 75-file offline product suite in a bounded parallel worker pool (~4.6× faster).

### Updated Extension Packages (npm)
- `pi-gemini-app@0.1.10`
- `openclaw-gemini-app@0.1.6`
- `mcp-gemini-app@0.1.1`
- `opencode-gemini-app@0.1.1`

## Verification
- Offline pre-release checks: 6/6 current-contract, 75/75 product tests, 71/71 Playwright browser E2E, 3/3 Python SDK smoke, 5/5 release package checks.
- Live real-upstream verification: 4 × 2.9 MiB PNGs, 24-image (~24 MiB) batch, `tool_choice: 'required'`, 28.9 KB slow tool call with 45s SSE keepalive flush, Gateway `POST /mcp`, `mcp-gemini-app` (gateway proxy & standalone direct stdio), and `opencode-gemini-app` on OpenCode `1.19.6`.

releases.name: v1.7.0 — Native Gateway POST /mcp, Trilingual Admin UI (EN/繁/简), Standalone MCP & OpenCode Plugins, and Pi 1.5.2 Session
releases.body:
## Highlights

### Native Gateway Streamable HTTP MCP (`POST /mcp`) & stdio Bridge (`bin/gemini-gateway mcp`)
- Added an in-process, API-key-authenticated Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP endpoint at `POST /mcp` exposing `ask_gemini` (with inline `data:` image support and LFI blocking of `images[].path`), `gemini_search` (grounded `native_search` + formatted Markdown citations), and `gemini_quota` (sanitized pool-level summary with zero emails, labels, tokens, or account IDs).
- Enforced DNS-rebinding `Origin` allowlist (`403 ORIGIN_REJECTED`), `MCP-Protocol-Version` validation (`2025-06-18` / `2025-03-26` / `2024-11-05`), strict JSON-RPC `-32700`/`-32600` responses, raw-byte `maxPromptBytes` enforcement before image decoding, and a persisted `mcpEnabled` setting (`403 MCP_DISABLED` when disabled without affecting `/v1/*`).
- Added `bin/gemini-gateway mcp` stdio bridge with HTTPS enforcement for non-loopback hosts, cwd `.env` isolation, bounded concurrency (`8`), typed JSON-RPC request-ID tracking, and client `notifications/cancelled` aborts.

### Trilingual Admin UI (`English` / `繁體中文` / `简体中文`) & MCP Controls
- Added a compact 3-language switcher (`EN | 繁 | 简`) with full Simplified Chinese (`zh-CN`) localization across all Admin Console views and a complete [`README.zh-CN.md`](https://github.com/ShawTim/gemini-app2api/blob/v1.7.0/README.zh-CN.md).
- Added MCP Quick Connect (`MCP` preset), Client Setup (`MCP Endpoint` URL + status badge + strict JSON `MCP (HTTP)` with `"type": "http"` and local-path `MCP (stdio)` tabs), API Keys dual `/v1` + `/mcp` endpoint strip, Settings `Enable MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint` switch, and `/mcp` request telemetry & onboarding recognition.

### Standalone Zero-Dependency Extensions (`extensions/mcp`, `extensions/opencode`)
- Added `mcp-gemini-app@0.1.0`: zero-dependency Node.js `>=22` stdio MCP server with fail-closed `owner`-tagged credential isolation, serialized `.reclaim` cross-process locking + pre-refresh inode-pinned `O_RDWR` updates, read-only external Pi auth support, retry account-epoch pinning, `O_NONBLOCK | O_NOFOLLOW` local image loading, and explicit `--accept-terms` ToS opt-in.
- Added `opencode-gemini-app@0.1.0`: zero-dependency Bun/Node OpenCode provider plugin with loopback & remote OAuth flows, explicit `GEMINI_OPENCODE_ACCEPT_TERMS=1` opt-in, per-loader isolated tier resolution before `gemini-auto` selection, post-tier-probe account identity verification, retry account-epoch pinning, deferred SSE error responses, and `ReadableStream.cancel()` upstream abort.

### Pi 1.5.2 Session Affinity (Fixes #4)
- Recognized hyphenated `session-id` in explicit session header resolution (`x-session-id` → `x-session-affinity` → `session-id` → `session_id`) with strict `INVALID_SESSION_ID` validation.
- Updated Pi `User-Agent` matching to support versioned `pi/<version> (...)` / `pi/<version>` headers (e.g. `pi/1.5.2 (win32; node/v24.13.0; x64)`) for `prompt_cache_key` fallback affinity.

### Verification
- Full offline pre-release suite passed: 75/75 staged product tests, 71/71 Playwright browser tests (390px + 1440px, light/dark, EN/繁/简), Python + JS SDK smoke tests, all 5 package release checks, and live 9-account gateway affinity verification.
- Multi-arch Docker image (`linux/amd64`, `linux/arm64`) published to `ghcr.io/shawtim/gemini-app2api:v1.7.0` and `:latest`.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ShawTim/gemini-app2api/compare/v1.6.6...v1.7.0

releases.name: v1.6.6 — Responses Multimodal function_call_output with Tool-Image Attribution (Fixes #3)
releases.body:
### Fixes
- **Responses `function_call_output` Multimodal Arrays** (`src/openai-contract.mjs`, `src/openai-usage.mjs`, Fixes #3 — thanks @xiao398008!):
  - Accepted array `output` on `POST /v1/responses` `function_call_output` items containing `input_text` and `input_image` parts (matching OpenAI Responses & `pi-ai`'s `convertToolResultOutput`), while strictly rejecting invalid part types (`output_text`, bare `text`, `logprobs`, `annotations`, `parsed`) and non-string/non-array `output` (`INVALID_TEXT`).
  - Preserved exact interleaved text positions and parallel tool-call attribution by inserting `[Tool image N for <call_id>]` markers in each tool result and flushing deferred tool images together as a labeled `user` image turn immediately after each consecutive `function_call_output` group (avoiding `PENDING_TOOL_CALLS` on parallel tool calls).
  - Added `function_call_output` `input_image` slots to `requestBudget()` (256 MiB image budget / shared `MAX_IMAGES = 256` cap) and `measurePromptImagePayload()` (258 tokens/image), and deduplicated inline base64 image decoding per request in `src/image-input.mjs` + `src/openai-contract.mjs` (4× → 1× decode).
  - Verified with offline unit/HTTP tests and live E2E against `gemini-neon` using both the exact Issue #3 payload (`200 OK`) and parallel multi-image attribution (`call_a=red, call_b=blue`).

### Internal Refactors
- Consolidated `NATIVE_VERSION` (`1.135.1.1291`), `GATEWAY_USER_AGENT` (`gemini-app2api/1.0`), and shared `MODEL_SPECS` across Gateway, Pi, and OpenClaw with drift-prevention tests (`5a1370b`).

> Note: `pi-gemini-app@0.1.9` and `openclaw-gemini-app@0.1.5` do not require version bumps for this release.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ShawTim/gemini-app2api/compare/v1.6.5...v1.6.6

releases.name: v1.6.5 — Dynamic Gateway & Admin UI Version Reporting (Fixes #2)
releases.body:
### Fixes
- **Dynamic Package Version** (`src/gateway/app.mjs`, `scripts/live-acceptance.mjs`): Replaced hardcoded `"1.5.3"` version strings in `overview()`, `GET /health` (and `/admin/api/diagnostics`), and `scripts/live-acceptance.mjs` with dynamic reads from `package.json` so the Admin UI, health probe, and diagnostics always report the installed release version. Fixes #2 (thanks @kyop21!).
- **Admin UI Version Pill Cleanup** (`src/admin-v2/app.js`): Removed the stale `'1.5.3'` fallback in `versionTag()` (hiding the version pill until `/admin/api/overview` finishes loading) and updated demo mode's synthetic version label to `'demo'`.
- **Regression Tests** (`test/gateway-http.test.mjs`, `test/admin-v2-static.test.mjs`): Added assertions verifying `GET /health`, `GET /admin/api/overview`, and `versionTag()` match `package.json` with zero stale version literals.

> Note: `pi-gemini-app@0.1.9` and `openclaw-gemini-app@0.1.5` are unchanged in this release.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ShawTim/gemini-app2api/compare/v1.6.4...v1.6.5
